name: input
title: Input 输入框
description: 单行文本输入，用于姓名、邮箱、搜索词等短文本。

whenToUse: 邮箱、密码、数字等带 type 的输入
accessibility: 必须有可见标签（用 Field 包裹）
错误信息用 aria-invalid 并关联说明文字
responsive: 移动端设置合适的 type 与 inputmode 以弹出正确键盘

files.content:
# Input 设计规范

- 每个 Input 都要有可见标签：放在 `Field.Field` 中，用 `Field.Label for={id}` 关联 Input 的 `id`；`placeholder` 只写示例，不能代替标签（检查规则 `valar/input-label`）。
- 默认高度 32 px，圆角使用 `md` 档（默认主题为 8 px），水平留白 12 px。Linear Profile 实测浅色底白色、边框 `lch(86.5% 0 282)`，深色底 `lch(9.232% .85 272)`、边框 `lch(30.833% 1.93 272)`。浅深主题的声明描边均为 0.5 px。桌面正文为 13 px，窄屏为 16 px。
- 点击或用 Tab 聚焦时，沿边框内侧绘制 1 px 蓝紫描边。边框用同主题的聚焦色阶，焦点即时出现。用 `readonly` 允许聚焦、选择、复制及表单提交，用 `disabled` 禁止编辑并跳过 Tab 和表单提交。
- 使用原生 `required`、`maxlength` 和类型约束。错误状态用 `aria-invalid="true"` 加 `Field.Error`，用 `aria-describedby` 关联错误文字。普通错误有危险色边框，焦点进入时以内侧描边区分。值修正后移除错误状态和对应的引用（检查规则 `valar/invalid-via-aria`）。
- Linear 新建团队用 32 px 高的标识符输入框搭配左侧标题和说明。上限 7 字符、转为大写并更新示例前缀是该表单的规则，由调用方实现。
- 按内容设置 `type`、`inputmode` 和 `autocomplete`（如 `type="email"`、`autocomplete="email"`），移动端才会弹出正确的键盘并允许自动填充。
- 有范围、步长或需要按地区格式化的数字用 Number Field，不要用 `type="number"`；多行文本用 Textarea；从固定选项中选择用 Select。
- 选择文件用 `<Input type="file" bind:files />`，不要自己写原生 `<input>`（检查规则 `valar/use-form-component`）。
- 高度、圆角、内边距跟随组件样式和组件参数（与 Button 同一套尺寸、圆角档位）；不要用 `class` 改 `rounded-*`、`px-*`。必须与同一行的小号按钮对齐时，只用与该按钮相同的高度档位类，不写像素值。
- 前后要加图标、文字或按钮时用 Input Group，不要用绝对定位把图标压在 Input 上。

<script lang="ts">
	import { cn, type WithElementRef } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import type { HTMLInputAttributes, HTMLInputTypeAttribute } from "svelte/elements";

	type InputType = Exclude<HTMLInputTypeAttribute, "file">;

	type Props = WithElementRef<
		Omit<HTMLInputAttributes, "type"> &
			({ type: "file"; files?: FileList } | { type?: InputType; files?: undefined })
	>;

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		value = $bindable(),
		type,
		files = $bindable(),
		class: className,
		"data-slot": dataSlot = "input",
		...restProps
	}: Props = $props();
</script>

{#if type === "file"}
	<input
		bind:this={ref}
		data-slot={dataSlot}
		class={cn(
			"border-[color:var(--valar-input-border,var(--valar-input-border-base,lch(86.5%_0_282)))] bg-[color:var(--valar-input-surface,var(--valar-input-surface-base,white))] dark:[--valar-input-border-base:lch(30.833%_1.93_272)] dark:[--valar-input-surface-base:lch(9.232%_.85_272)] dark:[--valar-input-focus:lch(47.918%_59.303_288.421)] aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 aria-invalid:border-destructive dark:aria-invalid:border-destructive/50 disabled:bg-input/50 dark:disabled:bg-input/80 h-8 rounded-md border-[0.5px] px-3 py-1 text-base transition-[border-color] file:h-6 file:text-sm file:font-medium aria-invalid:ring-1 aria-invalid:ring-inset md:text-[13px] motion-reduce:transition-none data-[slot=input]:placeholder:text-[color:lch(66%_1_282)] dark:data-[slot=input]:placeholder:text-[color:lch(39.452%_1.425_272)] md:data-[slot=input]:py-1.5 md:data-[slot=input]:leading-[normal] data-[slot=input]:focus:transition-none data-[slot=input]:focus:not-aria-invalid:border-[color:var(--valar-input-border-focus,lch(78.5%_0_282))] dark:[--valar-input-border-focus:lch(28.032%_6.93_272)] data-[slot=input]:focus:not-aria-invalid:outline-solid data-[slot=input]:focus:not-aria-invalid:outline-1 data-[slot=input]:focus:not-aria-invalid:-outline-offset-1 data-[slot=input]:focus:not-aria-invalid:outline-[color:var(--settings-focus,var(--valar-input-focus,lch(53%_52.26_286.91)))] data-[slot=input]:focus:aria-invalid:outline-solid data-[slot=input]:focus:aria-invalid:outline-1 data-[slot=input]:focus:aria-invalid:-outline-offset-1 data-[slot=input]:focus:aria-invalid:outline-destructive w-full min-w-0 outline-none file:inline-flex file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50",
			className
		)}
		type="file"
		bind:files
		bind:value
		{...restProps}
	/>
{:else}
	<input
		bind:this={ref}
		data-slot={dataSlot}
		class={cn(
			"border-[color:var(--valar-input-border,var(--valar-input-border-base,lch(86.5%_0_282)))] bg-[color:var(--valar-input-surface,var(--valar-input-surface-base,white))] dark:[--valar-input-border-base:lch(30.833%_1.93_272)] dark:[--valar-input-surface-base:lch(9.232%_.85_272)] dark:[--valar-input-focus:lch(47.918%_59.303_288.421)] aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 aria-invalid:border-destructive dark:aria-invalid:border-destructive/50 disabled:bg-input/50 dark:disabled:bg-input/80 h-8 rounded-md border-[0.5px] px-3 py-1 text-base transition-[border-color] file:h-6 file:text-sm file:font-medium aria-invalid:ring-1 aria-invalid:ring-inset md:text-[13px] motion-reduce:transition-none data-[slot=input]:placeholder:text-[color:lch(66%_1_282)] dark:data-[slot=input]:placeholder:text-[color:lch(39.452%_1.425_272)] md:data-[slot=input]:py-1.5 md:data-[slot=input]:leading-[normal] data-[slot=input]:focus:transition-none data-[slot=input]:focus:not-aria-invalid:border-[color:var(--valar-input-border-focus,lch(78.5%_0_282))] dark:[--valar-input-border-focus:lch(28.032%_6.93_272)] data-[slot=input]:focus:not-aria-invalid:outline-solid data-[slot=input]:focus:not-aria-invalid:outline-1 data-[slot=input]:focus:not-aria-invalid:-outline-offset-1 data-[slot=input]:focus:not-aria-invalid:outline-[color:var(--settings-focus,var(--valar-input-focus,lch(53%_52.26_286.91)))] data-[slot=input]:focus:aria-invalid:outline-solid data-[slot=input]:focus:aria-invalid:outline-1 data-[slot=input]:focus:aria-invalid:-outline-offset-1 data-[slot=input]:focus:aria-invalid:outline-destructive w-full min-w-0 outline-none file:inline-flex file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50",
			className
		)}
		{type}
		bind:value
		{...restProps}
	/>
{/if}
